summary: New York City, urbanist, strong advocate for universal basic income (UBI), environmentalism, biodiversity preservation, programming languages (Haskell, Rust), interest in public transportation and infrastructure, critical of capitalism and neoliberal policies, pro-union, anti-privatization, interest in ecological sustainability, engaged in discussions about social justice and economic inequality, supportive of cooperative business models, experienced in software development, particularly in functional programming, critical of traditional education systems, advocates for healthcare reform, interested in the intersection of technology and society.
